title: PDF password protector: encrypt a PDF
description: Add a password to a PDF so it won't open without it. AES-256 encryption, plus optional restrictions on printing, copying and editing. The file never leaves your device.

ui.restrict: Restrictions for people who open the file (optional)
ui.ownerHint: Must differ from the password to open, otherwise the restrictions won't work.
ui.ownerSame: The owner password is the same as the password to open, so the restrictions won't work. Choose a different one.
ui.remember: Write the password down: neither we nor anyone else can recover it.
